notes.zh-CN: 项目切换器支持直接移除主文件夹已失效的项目，并清理相关会话、最近目录与视图引用。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds the ability to remove a project whose main folder is missing from the project switcher, cleaning up its saved sessions, recents, and view references. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
